title: 2 soldiers wounded in clash with 'NPA' in Mindoro town

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Two government troopers were wounded in an encounter with suspected members of the New People’s Army (NPA) in Barangay San Roque, Bulalacao, the southernmost and one of the poorest towns in this province, on Monday morning. Brig. Gen. Melencio Ragudo, commander of the Army’s 203rd Infantry Brigade, said the clash broke out at 8:35 a.m. between elements of the 1st Infantry Battalion and seven alleged communist rebels in Sitio Gatol. Two soldiers sustained wounds to the shoulder and arm but were reported in stable condition following the incident. READ: Army troops clash with alleged rebels in […]...
